objective: Replace the remaining structured-text-only local adapters for Sankey, Treemap, Ishikawa, EventModeling, and Info with genuine deterministic terminal geometry as the next work unit toward all 29 Mermaid families. Base the work on actual Concise-mode inspection: Sankey currently prints Nodes/Flows tables; Treemap is only indentation; Ishikawa is only a Causes outline and duplicates Effect; EventModeling is only Frames/Data Entities text and loses the visible CreateOrder-to-ValidateOrder relationship; Info only prints info:. Sankey must render every node as a visible bounded shape/bar and every directed weighted link as a connected source-to-target route whose weight is visibly represented without dropping values or isolated nodes. Treemap must render closed nested rectangles that preserve hierarchy and use numeric values proportionally where present. Ishikawa must render a recognizable fishbone with a connected horizontal spine into an effect shape, angled main-cause bones, and connected nested causes while preserving every label exactly once. EventModeling must render ordered closed frame shapes, all source-frame relationships, frame kind/entity/inline/reference data, and connected data-entity shapes. Info has minimal semantics but must render a compact closed information card showing the parsed showInfo state instead of a bare label. Preserve Complete-mode canonical models and ensure Concise mode contains geometry rather than table/list/indentation fallbacks; support Unicode and ASCII, English and Chinese display widths, ANSI-independent geometry, deterministic output, control sanitization, and typed width/height/cell/byte/depth/entity limits before allocation. Add tests strong enough to prove closure, connection, hierarchy, direction, weight/proportion, semantic preservation, bilingual rendering, narrow dimensions, ASCII, determinism, and bounds; do not accept tests that merely check nonempty output or one glyph. Update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly. Do not modify or fork merman-core, merman-ascii, Selkie, or any parser. Apply KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and SOLID; reuse existing Canvas/box/chart primitives only when behavior is genuinely shared.

Implement terminal geometry for Sankey diagrams with node shapes/bars and routing for weighted directed links.
Implement terminal geometry for Treemap diagrams using proportional closed nested rectangles preserving hierarchical structure.
Implement terminal geometry for Ishikawa (fishbone) diagrams with a central spine into an effect shape, angled cause bones, and connected sub-causes.
Implement terminal geometry for EventModeling diagrams with closed frames, frame links/relationships, and connected data entity shapes.
Implement terminal geometry for Info diagrams rendering a compact closed information card displaying showInfo status.

Update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md to reflect the upgraded geometric adapters.
